items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-05-28
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Tad Jones; Tad Jones is identified only as the interviewer.

ctx.x: Any occasion. That's births, deaths, weddings.

Okay, well, alright. I've got to finish doing now. I've got to take this thing. Alright, we forgot to billboard the last one. This is an interview with Cosmo Matassa. My name's Tad Jones, and it's May 28, 1993. This is reel number two, and we've got to go back and billboard reel number one. And we're at Tulane University at the Jazz Archive. Okay, that's out of the way. Okay. So, speaking of food, how was the food growing up? I mean, we think about people in New Orleans eating red beans and rice, and here's a big…

Two things you've got to remember. I came up as a small child during the Depression. I was fortunate enough for my folks on the grocery store. So I was spared the problems other people had. You know, what do we eat today?
